recommendations.text: Spray DDT on all crops immediately to address the high severity fall armyworm alert.
Monitor and manage cutworm to prevent significant damage to the crops.
Adjust irrigation plans to avoid overwatering, especially in the irrigated plot (plot:003-2), given the recent heavy rainfall.
Check market prices and plan sales to maximize profits from the current stable sorghum price.
